captions: Tab. 10.31 Zusammenstellung der Eingabedaten für die Infrastruktur und den Betrieb der Konditionierungsanlage.
reason: Tab. 10.31 (p.296) collects the input data for the infrastructure AND the operation of the conditioning plant ('Konditionierungsanlage') in the Swiss context — the steel for the canisters, the welding, the electricity and the infrastructure share that this Swiss 'Nuclear spent fuel, in conditioning, at plant' dataset lists in its includedProcesses. Tab. 16.9/16.10 on p.405 are the Chinese (CN) conditioning plant and conditioning datasets, not the CH one; p.295 and p.297 are included for the introducing paragraph and any continuation.
